summary: @servicetitan/confirm-navigation preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated sibling file at the tarball root using obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array decoding (decoder function hc1jfK9). math_init.js is not listed in package.json files (which declares only dist and src) and its name has no relation to the package's advertised purpose (a React navigation-confirmation component). The alternate-runtime dropper pattern — fetching a second language runtime to execute an opaque, undeclared payload — bypasses scanners tied to Node semantics and produces arbitrary code execution as the installing user on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
